inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_PROFILE
inputs.description: The profile whose defaults apply.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_OVERLAY_FILES
inputs.description: Colon-separated target overlay files of NAME=value lines, applied in order above the schema defaults.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_PROTECTED_FILE
inputs.description: An owner-only file of NAME=value lines that may set only protected inputs, applied above the overlays.

inputs.name: HOME
inputs.description: The home directory the XDG defaults start from.

inputs.name: PATH
inputs.description: Where the server finds chrome, Xvfb, x11vnc, and ffmpeg; its child processes get this PATH and nothing else of the server's environment.

inputs.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
inputs.description: The XDG state directory; empty counts as unset.

inputs.name: XDG_CACHE_HOME
inputs.description: The XDG cache directory; empty counts as unset.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_STATE_DIRECTORY
inputs.description: Profiles, tasks, tokens, and the audit log; only the server's user may read it. Holds the admin socket.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_RECORDINGS_DIRECTORY
inputs.description: Session recordings, deleted after 7 days or beyond the cap.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_RECORDINGS_CAP_BYTES
inputs.description: The size the recordings directory may reach before the oldest recordings are deleted.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_WORK_DIRECTORY
inputs.description: Session working directories: profile copies and file areas, removed when sessions end.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_LISTEN_ADDRESS
inputs.description: The address of the HTTP listener for MCP, the dashboard, the CDP relay, and the model forwarder.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_PORT
inputs.description: The port of the HTTP listener.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
inputs.description: The origin clients and the dashboard use; dashboard links start with it and dashboard requests must carry it as Origin.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_SESSION_LIMIT
inputs.description: Managed sessions (profile, ephemeral, sign-in, and check sessions) open at once; more wait up to 60 seconds.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_SESSION_IDLE_SECONDS
inputs.description: Seconds without activity after which a session closes.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS
inputs.description: The age at which any session closes.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
inputs.description: Seconds after which a task run is killed and reported as timed out.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_SERVICE_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS
inputs.description: Seconds between scheduled runs of each service's check task.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_MODEL_BASE_URL
inputs.description: The OpenAI-compatible API base, ending in /v1, that the forwarder sends task runs' POST /responses to; empty disables model calls.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_MODEL_NAME
inputs.description: The model task runs' agent steps use.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_MODEL_KEY_FILE
inputs.description: An owner-only file holding the model API key the forwarder adds to each request.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_PROVIDERS
inputs.description: JSON list of external providers: {"name", "leaseUrl", "cdpHost", "tokenFile"}, each tokenFile an owner-only file.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
inputs.description: The deployment.environment.name resource attribute of exported telemetry.

inputs.name: OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER
inputs.description: Where spans go.

inputs.name: OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER
inputs.description: Where metrics go.

inputs.name: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
inputs.description: Where log records go.

inputs.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
inputs.description: The OTLP/HTTP base URL; signals go to its /v1/traces, /v1/metrics, and /v1/logs.

inputs.name: BROWSERCTL_OTLP_HEADERS_FILE
inputs.description: An owner-only file holding the OTLP export headers in OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS form, key=value pairs separated by commas.
